title: Trochoidal slot cuts outside the selection and into the model, reports OK; trochoid belongs in Adaptive as a strategy

labels.name: P1
labels.description: Unsafe or wrong output: gouge, collision, wrong G-code, crash, data loss; blocks a cut

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Reported by the maintainer (2026-11-13, in chat, with a screenshot of v0.19.0 bb5ecc43): "The trochoidal slot looks like it has a correct path.. This should be integrated as a method for "Adaptive" clearing tho, not a slot that doesnt confine itself within the selection.. Its an adaptive strategy" and "this is a bug".

What happens: a Trochoidal slot operation with a face selected (Face Body1, z=0.00, 1250 mm2) and endpoints A (-20, 0), B (20, 0), slot width 16 mm, tool 6 mm end mill generates 1445 moves and reports "OK" (2 warnings, both about Top below stock). The loops run past the selected face, across the pocket wall and into the model beside it. The page says "Boundary settings do not apply to it: a Trochoidal slot is authored by its two endpoints and width". Nothing confines the path to the selection or to the machinable region, and nothing refuses it.

Expected:
1. The trochoidal path is confined: it never cuts outside the selected region or into the model. A slot whose endpoints and width do not fit the region is refused by name with the numbers, or clipped only where that is provably safe; it is never reported "OK" (Prime Directive: never gouge).
2. Trochoidal motion is offered as a strategy of 2D Adaptive clearing (a method choice on the Adaptive operation, with a default, working inside the selected region and its boundary settings), not as a free-standing slot placed by two typed points. What happens to the stand-alone Trochoidal slot operation (kept as a confined slot, or folded into Adaptive with old projects migrated) is recorded in the PR's decision file.

Evidence: the screenshot in chat (status line: "generated Trochoidal slot1: 1445 moves (0 plunge(s), 10 level(s), 825 arc(s)), 290 warning(s) - trochoidal slot: 40 loops of radius 5.077 mm a level at a 0.9780 mm step, measured 64.5 deg engagement (limit 90.0 deg)"). Code: `crates/motion` trochoid slot (test suite `trochoid_slot`). Related: issue 47 (2D Adaptive trochoid).

To check first: whether the model gouge check runs for this operation at generate and at post. If a slot through the model posts clean, say so on this issue at once.

Done means: a test with the screenshot's setup (slot longer than the selected pocket face) is refused by name or stays inside the region, and never cuts the model; the gouge check covers the operation at the post; 2D Adaptive has a trochoidal method that stays inside its region (golden CL, engagement within the limit); undo, MCP parameter and the structural UI test cover the new choice.
